nodes.name: Webhook Trigger
nodes.notes: Receives trigger from Elevate AI /api/n8n/trigger-search. Body includes clerkUserId, targetRole, skills[], careerPlanGaps[], tavilyApiKey, callbackUrl, secret.

nodes.name: Respond to Webhook
nodes.notes: Immediately ack the trigger so Elevate AI doesn't time out waiting.

nodes.name: Get User Context
nodes.notes: Fetches user's targetRole, skills, careerPlanGaps, and searchKeywords from Elevate AI.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  api_key: $('Webhook Trigger').first().json.body.tavilyApiKey,
  query: ($json.targetRole || 'Software Engineer') + ' jobs hiring now ' + ($json.industry || '') + ' remote OR onsite',
  search_depth: 'advanced',
  max_results: 15,
  include_domains: [
    'linkedin.com',
    'indeed.com',
    'glassdoor.com',
    'wellfound.com',
    'jobs.lever.co',
    'greenhouse.io',
    'remotive.com',
    'builtin.com',
    'dice.com'
  ]
}) }}

nodes.name: Search Jobs via Tavily
nodes.notes: Calls Tavily search API (already configured in Elevate AI .env). Searches across LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor, Wellfound etc. API key is passed securely from Elevate AI trigger payload.

nodes.name: Score & Filter Jobs
nodes.notes: Extracts company/title/salary/location from Tavily search results and scores 0-100 based on role + skill + career-plan-gap keyword matches. Filters out low-relevance results.

nodes.name: Send Results to Elevate AI
nodes.notes: POSTs filtered/scored jobs to /api/webhooks/n8n/job-results. Elevate AI upserts them into JobApplication table and they appear in /jobs.

setup_instructions.step1: Import this file into n8n: Workflows → Import from File
setup_instructions.step2: NO API key config needed in n8n — Elevate AI passes your TAVILY_API_KEY securely in the trigger payload
setup_instructions.step3: Add to .env.local: N8N_WEBHOOK_URL=<your n8n webhook URL>  N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET=<any secret>
setup_instructions.step4: Activate the workflow in n8n and copy the Production Webhook URL into N8N_WEBHOOK_URL
setup_instructions.step5_optional_schedule: Add a Schedule Trigger node (daily at 9am) for automatic daily searches — wire it into 'Get User Context' and set clerkUserId + secret + callbackUrl directly in the node
